firstPlayerRule: The youngest player starts by placing any of their game tiles in the center of the table.
houseFallback: If the official instruction leaves an unresolved tie or cannot be applied, agree to choose randomly. This is this site's suggested house rule.
clarifications: The oldest player keeps score with the score pad and pencil; that role is separate from starting.
